integrity: The published extremal theorem identifying alternating arches is checked against the full primary text. The new binary count is proved by an explicit two-state recurrence with a Fibonacci envelope. Independent direct enumeration reconstructs universality and SAS sets for all binary words through length twelve.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is restricted to binary alphabets and shortest absent subsequences. The equality classification is proved only among minimum-length k-universal words of length 2k. No closed form is claimed for larger alphabets or longer absent subsequences.
title: Fibonacci extremum for binary shortest absent subsequences
